rationale: This is a mechanical recombination of two archive legs (the intan/at leg from SoftCollateralLeverage and the NEG(oancf/lt) leg from GoodwillStockWeakCashCoverage), and since Compustat `intan` is a superset containing `gdwl`, it is close to a broadened relabeling of the archive leader rather than a genuinely new mechanism.

Despite the disclaimer, this is a horizon variant of the archive's ReinvestmentAgainstDebtServiceCapacity (capx/ppent × NEG(oancf/lt)) — replacing one-year capex with a five-year sum in the same numerator over a closely related denominator will be highly correlated with the original, so the "vintage vs. flow" distinction it claims to test is not cleanly identified.

The expression is internally consistent and the tangible-net-worth conditioner is a defensible covenant-relevant reframing, though it algebraically reduces to a monotone function of (intan/at + lt/at), i.e. an additive version of the two legs already multiplied in SoftCollateralLeverage, so its incremental information over the archive is modest.

Replacing the goodwill stock with its three-year increment is a substantive stock-versus-flow decomposition of the archive leader with a clear diagnostic payoff (and it usefully assigns low signal values to firms that have already impaired), though the acquisition-flow leg overlaps with the known asset-growth/acquisition anomaly and with DebtFundedAcquisitionProgram.

The stated hypothesis is conditional ("among firms carrying heavy obligations") but the rank-product construction loads directly on the leverage main effect, so with a positive expected sign the signal is long high-leverage firms — precisely the exposure that has produced negative alphas in three archive signals — meaning a null result will be uninformative about investment smoothness.

The reasoning misdescribes the data — `txt` is total income tax expense including the deferred component, not cash taxes paid (`txpd`), so it is neither "hardest to manage upward" nor immune to accrual management — and the leg is in practice a scaled profitability proxy, making the signal a near-restatement of the well-known investment × low-profitability (CMA × RMW) interaction already present in the archive.
